title: Put the agreed design-review guidance in Engram's architecture reviewer lens and the coder skill
outcome: Put the agreed design-review guidance in Engram's architecture reviewer lens and the coder skill
acceptance: `.claude/reviewers/architecture.md` contains, verbatim, the guidance agreed by both coordinators: "For a new mechanism or a significant behavior change, the item states the goal, the observed problem, the proposed behavior and its cost before code. The project coordinator chooses the design reviewers before code; they check necessity, simpler existing alternatives, real host behavior and possible damage to functionality. Do not require protection for hypothetical scenarios; a severity label is not evidence. Do not dismiss a concrete correctness defect merely because no incident has occurred. Small fixes use ordinary review only."
`.agents/skills/coder-test-execution/SKILL.md` gains one "before code" sentence carrying the first sentence of that guidance

The pre-code design-review bullet in AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and .claude/commands/review-changes.md scopes the review to new mechanisms or significant behavior changes and says the project coordinator chooses read-only design reviewers. It uses the agreed wording and architecture link, preserves the command’s advisory provenance, and names no session. AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md remain identical. The clean Markdown-only candidate passes a focused link check and gets a fresh independent review pair. No other text changes.
